summary.text: Golden cloud divine wood is an immortal material that looks like shining gold yet is wood, used in refinement of an immortal zombie body.

claims.text: Golden cloud divine wood leaves the refinement path immortal formation as a wooden log that looks like shining gold but is wood on closer look. Dewdrops on the log resemble amber, and delicate clouds form and vanish on its surface. Kept in the formation and nourished by hundred flowers concentrate, it is one of the Gu materials linked with the immortal zombie body and Spring Autumn Cicada. The formation breaks the wood apart until it disintegrates, and matching wooden markings, amber-like dewdrops, and delicate clouds appear on the immortal zombie body.
After that step finishes, Fang Yuan’s strength path immortal zombie body has completely turned into a human-shaped golden cloud divine wood before the next immortal material is brought out.
